headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 7, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance. The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Athletics 6-5 in a closely contested game, while the New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians, securing a 13-6 win. The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 5-2 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, handing the Pirates their loss.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Cleveland Guardians right-handed pitcher Slade Cecconi due to right arm fatigue, Chicago White Sox left-handed pitcher Chris Murphy with a left flexor strain, and Chicago White Sox catcher Joey Bart with a fifth metacarpal fracture in his left hand. The Kansas City Royals transferred right-handed pitcher Luinder Avila from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right forearm tightness.

The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins in a trade. The Athletics acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.

top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Athletics 6-5 in a closely contested game. Brian Serven led the Athletics' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians in Thrilling 13-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians, securing a 13-6 win. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Brewers Take Down Pirates in 5-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 5-2 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, handing the Pirates their loss. Gary Sánchez led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Aaron Ashby pitched a strong 1.0 inning in relief for the Brewers.

top_news.title: **Cecconi Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cleveland Guardians right-handed pitcher Slade Cecconi has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right arm fatigue. The move is effective immediately.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as part of a trade.
